name: The Virtuous Woman
overview: Scripture portrays the virtuous woman as a precious and praiseworthy blessing, esteemed by her community and invaluable to her husband. She is described as more precious than rubies, a crown to her husband, and a prudent gift from the Lord, highlighting her wisdom and character as surpassing material wealth. The contrast with a contentious woman underscores the peace and honor a virtuous woman brings to her household, reflecting the high value God places on her godly attributes.
